inputs.prompt: Animate this exact hand-drawn 2D Japanese anime frame. Preserve ink outlines, hard-edged cel shading, flat matte skin, broad hair locks and painted gothic backgrounds throughout. Preserve identities, clothing, number of characters and established scenery. Intentional animation with anticipation, force, follow-through and settle; no loop, CGI, extra limbs, character morphing, unrelated cut, orbit or unmotivated zoom. Immediately after a one-frame-like silver teleport flash, show this exact Kimi finishing a low crouched landing at the altar. Both boots are planted, her knees flex once to absorb her weight, torso settles and hair/skirt follow through. Fine silver threads dissipate from around her boots during the first half second. She holds the pale crescent ring blade in her LEFT hand and dark one in RIGHT; keep both exact C shapes. A compact indigo force pushes the nearest black-violet burning logs sideways OUTWARD away from the cross. End stable in crouch, ready to rise. Fixed low camera, no jump before landing, no blade pickup, no extra body, no orange wood flames.
